solution.what: George Lasry (with ChatGPT Astra 6 and Anthropic Opus 5.5) transcribed and deciphered the item: 15/15 pages transcribed; 9/11 cipher pages deciphered; 2 more in part; 440 elements, 370 identified (84.1%); 4 assumed readings; 50 ?. Report section: see report.

Spot-check against the Gallica image (https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/btv1b52517729k/f67.item): f32r = Solferino telegram "Cavriana 24 juin 1859, Empereur a Imperatrice", clear text + code "941 325 274 1155 / 163 1142 1162"; his key gives 274=connais, 163=ble, 1142=s (fragmentary, no excerpt covers this run); f19r/f35r excerpts not image-checked Verdict: partly confirmed.

Jozef Krajčovič (issue #39) re-read f9r, f15r, f17r, f18r by hand and applied Lasry's key (not a ciphertext-only re-solution): agreements e.g. f15r sans résistance, f18r Castiglione; proposed token corrections f9r 1143->1193 (419 = es), f18r 1268->1265, f15r 1115->1155, f17r 839->889 and 353->355, provisional 1200 = sort; f21r-v (Emperor to the War Ministry) is a different nomenclator. Not applied: the transcription and key are Lasry's; passed to him. Extent corrected from 'already solved' to read in part (9 of 11 cipher pages, 84.1% of elements).

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): Lasry's report excerpts (lasry_entry.md) and Krajčovič's proposed token corrections (NOTES.md) copied as separate files under texts/. Lasry's full token transcription, full decryption of the cipher pages and key table are not in the repository; Krajčovič's token streams are on issue #39 only.
